title: melinis leucantha
intro: Melinis leucantha, commonly known as Buffalo Grass or White Top, is a type of grass native to tropical Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Melinis leucantha include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents present in Melinis leucantha contribute to its potential health benefits and are being studied for their antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
